[judgement] S1-011: the test takes a secret, derives k = n/4 (?) rows and fits the Grover slope. The four-point mean and the sum-of-squares are written for exactly four rows, so any change in the row count silently divides by the wrong constant. Replace the hand-rolled fit with a median of 41 independent draws of the same regression slope and assert the same bounds (0.5 delta 0.06), and report the median plus the interquartile range in the test output. This changes the file's sha256; record the original bytes in records/ before the edit.
